page_title: VER 3-0 NAP | Verona v Napoli 18/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' 3 - 0 Daniel Mosquera (Verona) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
90+3' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
90+3' Matteo Politano (Napoli) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man. Napoli force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+1' Half-chance! Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) plays a pass into the box, but Lorenzo Montipo reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90+1' Matteo Marchetti shows a yellow card to Reda Belahyane (Verona) for a tough tackle.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) sees a yellow card from Matteo Marchetti after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
88' Ondrej Duda (Verona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
87' A cross into the box from Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) is cleared.
85' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Napoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
84' Matteo Politano (Napoli) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
83' Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) latched on to the corner and struck a fine header from the edge of the box, but he missed the target.
83' The referee awards a corner and Ondrej Duda (Verona) goes over to take it.
82' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) latches onto a cross and shoots from close-range, but Alex Meret makes a terrific save to deny him. The referee signals a corner kick to Verona.
81' The Verona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
80' Darko Lazovic (Verona) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Antonio Conte has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) replacing Juan Jesus.
79' The referee signals a substitution. Walid Cheddira (Napoli) is brought on as a substitute for Giovanni Simeone.
77' Today's referee Matteo Marchetti rightly decides to book Ondrej Duda (Verona) for his harsh tackle.
75' 2 - 0 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Daniel Mosquera (Verona) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom right corner. Good team effort!
74' Paolo Zanetti decides to make a substitution. Dailon Rocha Livramento will be replaced by Abdou Harroui (Verona).
73' Casper Tengstedt (Verona) is flagged for offside.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Casper Tengstedt trots off the pitch and is replaced by Daniel Mosquera (Verona).
71' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
70' Matteo Politano (Napoli) works the corner short.

70' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. Now Napoli have a corner.
68' Tomas Suslov (Verona) is caught offside!
66' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
65' A loose ball is pounced on by Frank Anguissa (Napoli) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Lorenzo Montipo is alert and makes a comfortable save.
64' Tomas Suslov (Verona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
63' Ondrej Duda (Verona) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Matteo Marchetti stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
61' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) wastes a promising chance as he unleashes a first-time shot from mid-range which hits the crossbar!
58' Paolo Zanetti has decided to make a change. Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) replaces Martin Frese.
58' A substitution has been made. Grigoris Kastanos goes off and Tomas Suslov (Verona) comes on.

58' Darko Lazovic (Verona) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Matteo Marchetti with no other option than to blow for a foul.
57' Rough tackle by Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Napoli are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
54' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
53' The ball is cleared after Darko Lazovic (Verona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
51' Here comes a substitution. Mathias Olivera (Napoli) is brought on as a substitute for Leonardo Spinazzola.

50' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona). Darko Lazovic plays a fantastic through ball and finds Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the right side of the goal. It's now 1:0.
49' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.

48' What a chance that is! Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
47' Good movement by Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) replaces him.
45+3' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.
45+3' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
45+2' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

45+1' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Darko Lazovic (Verona) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
45' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) commits a rough challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) blows a golden chance from inside the box, volleying the ball narrowly over the crossbar. What a miss!
41' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
40' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
40' Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
39' Juan Jesus (Napoli) makes a rough challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Juan Jesus (Napoli) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and flies wide of the target.
38' Matteo Politano (Napoli) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
37' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Napoli win a corner.
36' A thunderous effort from long range by Frank Anguissa (Napoli) goes well wide of the left post.
34' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
34' A cross is slung in towards the penalty spot and Frank Anguissa (Napoli) creates space for himself but sends his header inches over the bar.
33' Napoli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
30' Darko Lazovic (Verona) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
30' The expression of the referee Matteo Marchetti is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) is shown a yellow card.
27' A cooling break is underway.
27' The game is interrupted. Frank Anguissa (Napoli) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
22' Neat passing move from Napoli in order to create new attacking opportunities.
21' Suat Serdar is substituted due to injury. Paolo Zanetti gives a chance to Reda Belahyane (Verona).
20' It doesn’t look good for Suat Serdar (Verona); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
20' The foul by Diego Coppola (Verona) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Matteo Marchetti.
19' Matteo Politano (Napoli) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
17' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) was too forceful with his tackle and Matteo Marchetti interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
15' The game is interrupted now, Suat Serdar (Verona) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
14' Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) makes a strong challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul.
12' Great teamplay by Verona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
11' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom left corner is far too weak and Lorenzo Montipo makes a simple save.
9' Suat Serdar (Verona) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
7' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
6' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul.
4' Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alex Meret intercepts the ball.
4' Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul after Frank Anguissa (Napoli) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
2' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
2' The Napoli players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Napoli will take the kick-off.
Matteo Marchetti is the one to supervise the game today.
